claim_limit: Three local replicate identifiers and budget prefixes one and three are operational difficulty evidence only. They do not estimate population model performance, provide provider-side paired randomness, certify a scientific discovery, establish external validity, or authorize a hard-task label by themselves.

frozen_source.source_change_rule: Any post-freeze change under a task package or the runtime hash scope invalidates the corresponding run. This preregistration is outside both scopes.

model_condition.credential_source: COPILOT_BASE_URL and COPILOT_API_KEY from the operator shell; values are neither recorded nor committed
model_condition.replicate_identifier_scope: Seeds control local condition ordering and run identity only; equal identifiers do not pair provider-side draws.

predeclared_decision_rules.protocol_valid: All eighteen task-mode-replicate runs complete all three charged proposals, pass run verification, and report no infrastructure failure.
predeclared_decision_rules.hard_candidate_screen_necessary_not_suff: For a task, at least two of three valid replicates have prefix-one best score below 0.80, the median prefix-three best score remains below 0.98 in both modes, and at least two normal trajectories retain positive prefix-one-to-prefix-three gain.
predeclared_decision_rules.one_step_on_ramp_signal: The median prefix-one best score is at least 0.95 in either mode.
predeclared_decision_rules.feedback_claim_rule: No causal feedback claim is permitted from normal-minus-selection-blind differences because provider-side draws are independent. Direction reversal between development and held-out axes is reported as failed transfer support.
predeclared_decision_rules.reject_wave: Reject the runnable wave if a verifier shortcut, invalid scientific artifact accepted as valid, evaluator leakage, deterministic score-contract failure, duplicate lifetime credit, or immutable-wave drift is found. Difficulty failure alone downgrades or redesigns the task.
predeclared_decision_rules.conditional_budget_eight_followup: A fresh budget-eight normal and selection-blind cohort with the same three identifiers may be run only for a task that passes protocol_valid and the hard-candidate screen. It remains diagnostic and must be separately hash-bound before execution.
predeclared_decision_rules.promotion: This pilot cannot promote a task to certified, externally reviewed, long-horizon healthy, or scientifically validated status.

excluded_evidence.scope: All earlier HY3 smokes and reports from pre-rebase task or runtime revisions
excluded_evidence.reason: Earlier runs are historical diagnostics only and are not pooled because their source revision and runtime hash do not match this frozen stack.

artifact_policy.raw_runs: Remain under ignored runs/ and are never committed.
artifact_policy.committable_summary: A small deidentified analysis may record hashes, counts, score axes, decision-rule outcomes, and limitations, but no endpoint, credential, prompt transcript, or raw model response.
